meta.text: Now the cost model in one line — and I want you to actually memorize this, because it prunes away most wrong answers. Total = the DBU rate times DBU-hours, plus the cloud VM price times runtime. Two terms, always. The DBU term is Databricks' own billing unit; the VM term is what the cloud provider charges for the machines. Every optimization you evaluate has to be judged against both terms. A change that halves runtime but doubles worker count can easily lose money — and that's precisely the trap these questions set.
